title: T3 Versioned vendor price book with cache, long-context tiers and published-page source
description: Supersedes chatticus-12ba7f. Files: conversation/src/ledger/vendor-prices.ts, conversation/src/ledger/vendor-ledger.ts (costUsdFromTokens), conversation/src/gateway/model-gateway.ts, conversation/src/turn/openai-models.ts, docs/BUDGETS.md price table. Give every allowed model input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite and tiers (above 272000 input for gpt-6-luna per pi-ai openai.json), a priceBookId naming source and retrieval date, verified against OpenAI's own page not LiteLLM. Unpriced model fails the Lambda turn closed with a clear reason. Vitest guard: gateway-allowed models equal price book models. Acceptance: scenarios 6, 7, 8, 9 of the plan list pass; docs/BUDGETS.md table updated.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented in PR 537 (branch ts/cost-price-book, not merged). Price book now versioned (openai@2026-10-13+pi-ai-1.0.2) with cacheRead, cacheWrite and the gpt-6-luna tier above 272000 context tokens; sourced from the pi-ai 1.0.2 bundled openai catalog, NOT yet verified against OpenAI's own page. Calls are priced individually by their own model and context size; unpriced model fails the turn before the model call and a spend record is marked unpriced_calls with no cost_usd. Scenarios 6, 8, 9 of the plan are covered by features/cost_price_book.feature; scenario 7 (reasoning within output) is by construction (output priced as output) and not separately asserted. Not done: verification against OpenAI's page, rollup surfacing of unpriced_calls, service tier pricing, T4.

right_now_summary: A price-book implementation is in an unmerged PR, but source checks and service-tier pricing remain.
